values.note: Missouri State Parks' reservation site or 877-422-6766, up to 12 months ahead. 'Reservable sites may be available on a walk-up registration basis if the site is not reserved.' Camping is limited to any 15 days within a 30-consecutive-day period. The booking system's restriction for this campground is a 1-night minimum, summer weekends included (checked June 11 and July 3, 2027).

booking.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/pershing-state-park/camping ('reserve your Missouri State Parks campsite up to 12 months in advance'; walk-up line; 15-in-30 rule) + https://msprdr.usedirect.com/MSPRDR/rdr/search/grid FacilityId 811 (Restrictions: MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 15, booking 2026-10-20 to 2027-10-20), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 38 campsites on the reservation system: 26 electric 30-amp (listed vehicle lengths 36-63 ft) and 12 basic (23-85 ft), plus a special-use camping area.

facilities.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/pershing-state-park/camping (Campground Amenities symbols: shower, dump station, laundry, vault toilet, running water, frost-free water; 'Showers/Water Available Apr 15-Oct 31'), read 2026-10-20

note: Small campground near the Locust Creek wetland with 26 30-amp electric and 12 basic sites; showers and water April 15 - October 31. Reservable online up to 12 months ahead; unreserved sites can be taken walk-up. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on Missouri's US eDirect site (12-month window, walk-up after_cutoff, 15-night max now on the entry) and 30-amp electric. Added 38 sites (26 electric, 12 basic) to 85 ft, showers/dump/laundry/vault toilets/water. Corrected the --Claude note's 'two-night weekend minimum': the booking system's minimum here is 1 night on summer weekends, and Missouri's two-night weekend rule names seven other parks. Season (year-round, showers Apr 15-Oct 31) and fees left as recorded.
